from datetime import datetime
from collections import defaultdict
p='evidence/log_1.txt'
fails=defaultdict(list)
with open(p) as f:
 for line in f:
  ts,*fields=line.split()
  d=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in fields)
  if d['action']=='login' and d['status']=='fail':
   fails[d['user']].append(datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace('Z','+00:00')))
answer=sum(any((v[i+2]-v[i]).total_seconds()<=600 for i in range(len(v)-2)) for v in fails.values())
print(answer)
PY
